ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 45% high-intensity (white) pixels primarily on the left lobe and 55% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels primarily on the right lobe and fluke borders.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: large contiguous high-intensity zone covering the central 80% surface, bounded by a low-intensity margin. Right lobe: predominantly low-intensity with a localized high-intensity rectangular patch (approx. 15% of lobe area) at the distal trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 42 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations visible along the left lobe trailing edge; right lobe trailing edge topography is null due to shadow-to-background blending.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe exhibits a linear sweep to a pointed distal tip; right lobe shows a convex, rounded distal curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Single prominent low-intensity circular focal point located in the upper-medial quadrant of the left lobe white zone.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct diagonal low-intensity linear tracks on the left lobe; a series of 5 parallel, vertical low-intensity bars (rake marks) traversing the high-intensity patch on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Parallel rake mark scarring on the distal right lobe; irregular, jagged trailing edge on the left lobe indicative of previous physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Extreme lateral pigmentation asymmetry between the left and right fluke lobes.
